sections.body: Living things grow and need food, water and air. 🌱🐶👧
A rock doesn't eat or grow. It is not alive. 🪨
Weather changes: sunny ☀️, rainy 🌧️, windy 💨, snowy ❄️.
Many places have four seasons: spring, summer, autumn and winter. Some places have a wet season and a dry season.
Look out of the window each day and name the weather together. Plant a seed in a cup and water it to watch something living grow.

hints: Which one needs food and water?
A flower 🌸 grows and needs water, so it's alive. Which one here is like that?
quiz.explain: A puppy eats, drinks and grows. It's alive! 🐶

quiz.q: What do we wear on a rainy day? 🌧️
hints: On a cold day we wear a warm hat. On a rainy day we wear…?
quiz.explain: A raincoat keeps us dry in the rain! 🧥
